name: @skastr0/quartz-workspace

scripts.build: bun run engine:build && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run verify:package-boundaries
scripts.pack:dry-run: bun run build && bun run build:npm-cli && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/engine" && npm pack --dry-run "./apps/opencode-plugin" && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/npm/quartz-darwin-arm64" && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/npm/quartz-darwin-x64" && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/npm/quartz-linux-arm64" && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/npm/quartz-linux-x64" && npm pack --dry-run "./packages/npm/quartz"
scripts.smoke:npm-cli: bun run build:npm-cli && node packages/npm/quartz/bin/quartz.js capabilities
scripts.release:check: bun run verify && bun run pack:dry-run && bun run smoke:npm-cli && bun run verify:regression-guard && bun audit && publish-scan .

description: TypeScript code intelligence and transform search tooling.
